notes: Four wild-type EPEC prototype strains in LB vs DMEM (DMEM = virulence-inducing medium, a medium property, treatment none). No control condition is named, so is_control left out. DMEM without serum -> cell_culture / defined_rich, amino acids true (inferred). OD 0.5 -> mid_exponential (inferred) in both media; DMEM is neither complex nor minimal but 0.5 is inside both ranges. Carbon source not stated.
